rawFindings.title: Incorrect router used in HTTP verb method handlers
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces usage of `this._router.route(path)` with `this._baseRoute(path)` in the HTTP verb methods (e.g., app.get, app.post, etc.) and in app.all. The `_baseRoute` method ensures the route is cached and reused, preventing duplicate routes for the same path. However, `_baseRoute` relies on `this._baseRoutes` cache, which is newly added here and initialized in `app.init`. This alters the behavior such that multiple calls to the same HTTP verb and path share the same route, enabling midd
rawFindings.suggestion: Review the compatibility impact of switching to `_baseRoute` caching in method handlers. If multiple handlers per verb and path must be supported, consider retaining the previous behavior or documenting that handlers override prior ones.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With this change, registering multiple app.get('/path', handler) calls will overwrite previous handlers rather than stacking them, causing only the last handler to be executed instead of all handlers.
